_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with flat 30d momentum and mid-band fear/funding/DXY; no single breaker, so HOLD is the graded base-rate call while crowded longs keep the lean cautious.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative implies unwind risk from crowded longs without a directional phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, fear/greed ~40-55, 30d momentum flat, ETF flows remain dead
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows and momentum surge together (rung up) or crowded longs unwind on vol spike and price breakdown (rung down)
